annotations.title: Approve or reject a proposed project memory

description: Approve or reject one proposed memory note for this project, as the user would in Berrys. Approved notes are read by the Berrys agent on later turns; rejected ones are archived. External apps cannot approve memory proposals; the user must review them in Berrys.

decision.description: Whether to approve or reject the proposed memory; rejected notes are archived.

projectId.description: ID of the Playground project chosen for this task; obtain it from project creation, an explicit project link or current context.
